name: Organisation Identification 49
definition: Provides the identification of the organisation.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: The legal entity identifier code of the organisation.

OrganisationName.name: Organisation Name
OrganisationName.definition: Name of an organisation along with the language in which it is provided or an indication whether it is international.

RegisteredCountry.name: Registered Country
RegisteredCountry.definition: Country of establishment of the entity.

EntitySize.name: Entity Size
EntitySize.definition: Size of the entity according to a taxonomy from a regulation.

Sector.name: Sector
Sector.definition: The industry sector(s) of the economic activities of the legal person.

PersonName.name: Person Name
PersonName.definition: Indicates the name of the natural person when a natural person is acting as legal person.||Usage: the complete name, including first name, last name, and where applicable according to the regulation, middle name and surname.

NPI.name: NPI
NPI.definition: Natural person acting as a legal person, identified through the natural person identifier.
